characters.name: Lyra Vale
characters.notes: Searching for the source of ash storms along the old trade road.

npcs.name: Mara Flint
npcs.description: A soot-streaked scout who knows every broken milestone on the Ember Road.

locations.name: Ashen Crossroads
locations.description: Four roads meet beneath leaning waystones dusted with warm gray ash.

locations.name: Fallow Watchtower
locations.description: A ruined signal tower overlooking the blackened valley.

encounters.name: Ash Wolves
encounters.description: Three hungry wolves with ember-bright eyes stalk the roadside.
encounters.reward: A charred courier satchel with a sealed map.

quests.title: Find the Source of the Ash Storms
quests.description: Track the strange ash falls to whatever is burning beneath the valley.

objectives.text: Question Mara Flint at the crossroads.

scenes.title: Warm Ash on the Wind
scenes.text: The road ahead vanishes into a low curtain of ash. Mara Flint waits beside a cracked milestone, one hand resting on the hilt of her knife.

actions.label: Speak with Mara
actions.resultText: Mara points toward the Fallow Watchtower and warns that the ash wolves hunt before dusk.
actions.journalEntry: Mara says the ash grows warmer near the Fallow Watchtower.

actions.label: Search the road
actions.resultText: You find fresh pawprints burned into the dust.
actions.journalEntry: Ash wolf tracks cross the road. They are fresh.

scenes.title: The Fallow Watchtower
scenes.text: The tower rises from the ridge like a broken tooth. Beneath it, something glows through cracks in the stone.

actions.label: Enter the tower
actions.resultText: A hot draft rolls down the stairs, carrying the smell of iron and old smoke.
actions.journalEntry: The tower hides a heat source below its foundation.

actions.label: Make a cautious camp
actions.resultText: You mark a sheltered hollow and settle in for a tense watch.
actions.journalEntry: Made camp near the Fallow Watchtower.
